name: @sparx/platform-crm
description: Mirror sparx tenant lifecycle into the PLATFORM tenant's own CRM (docs/140). A tenant signing up becomes a contact + a deal on the wizeworks 'Tenant Signups' pipeline; later lifecycle (rename, module activation, subscription change) moves that deal. Shared so BOTH the platform-crm-worker (prod, Pub/Sub) and the signup flow (dev/in-process) mirror identically.
